stories.title: Fflint Wrecsam MS cites Connah’s Quay family in Sir Galahad evidence call
stories.summary: Marc Jones MS has called for all documents on the RFA Sir Galahad disaster to be released, citing a Connah’s Quay father whose son died aboard the ship. stories.title: North Wales man jailed over £4m of machinery obtained on finance
stories.summary: A Prestatyn man has been jailed for five years after taking heavy plant machinery on finance and selling it abroad without repaying the loans. stories.title: Flintshire roadworks: closures and temporary traffic lights across the county this week
stories.summary: Road closures and temporary traffic lights are in place across Flintshire this week, with works in Shotton, Mold, Buckley, Hope and Pen-y-ffordd among those listed in Flintshire County Council’s roadworks bulletin. stories.title: Deeside Industrial Park 20mph limit set to be reversed on most roads
stories.summary: Roads across Deeside Industrial Park will return to 30mph from 16 October, reversing the 20mph limit brought in under Wales’ default speed limit in 2023. stories.title: Diesel close to all-time high as Fflint Wrecsam MS questions Welsh Government on fuel
stories.summary: Fflint Wrecsam MS Nigel Williams says he has asked the Welsh Government whether it has raised fuel prices with retailers and the UK Government, as diesel nears a record high. The average price of a litre of diesel reached 198.32p on Friday, according to the RAC, less than a penny short of the all-time high
